name: two-stage secondary screen (K-filter -> P-pick)
stage_2a_K: Kronos base frozen embedding (last-hidden) -> StandardScaler -> PCA(8) -> Ridge(alpha=10); drop bottom 50% of day's candidates by K-score
stage_2b_P: prior-day(D-1) intraday features -> HistGBDT; rank survivors, take top N (default 3-4)

live_inputs.K: Kronos base emb of code's daily K-line context (bars < buyDate), via kronos_lib.embed_contexts
live_inputs.optional_live: stock_call_auction(code, today) imbalance (buyVol2-sellVol2)/pctChange as final tie-break (not backtestable)

validated_oos.caveat: edge concentrated in 主板; main-board-only paired p=0.147 (borderline); robust across N=3-5 and 4/6 months
